PropertyList.comment:
B-Shell display shell: generic UDP input protocol for JSBSim 6-DoF trajectory replay.
FG is a pure display shell (fdm=null). The physics authority is JSBSim: trajectories come from rl_train/results/jsbsim_ppo_*_trajectory.json and are streamed by platform/fg_shell/playback.py.
Packet = 8 comma separated floats, newline terminated: latitude_deg, longitude_deg, altitude_ft, roll_deg, pitch_deg, heading_deg, groundspeed_kt, rotor_rpm
Usage: --generic=socket,in,30,127.0.0.1,5500,udp,jsbsim_replay
NOTE: rendered model is bo105 as a VISUAL STAND-IN; the simulated physics is AH-1S (repaired). Every public output of this pipeline must disclose this.
